experiment_data.hypothesis: Prolog exec-only GRPO seed=44: third seed for Prolog exec-only. Together with s42 (PR=83%, ISR=0.031) and s43, provides 3-seed evidence for cross-logic generalization claim (Claim 3). 3-seed mean±std required for paper.
experiment_data.notes: Eval 完成。PR=21% (3-seed 最低), ISR=0.081, proved_only_ISR=0.387 (max_ISR=1.0)。与 s42/s43 不同模式：PR 极低但 proved_only_ISR 较高，可能有少量样本 ISR=1 (H7-like)。Prolog exec-only 3-seed 汇总：s42 PR=83%/ISR=0.031, s43 PR=56%/ISR=0.008, s44 PR=21%/ISR=0.081。Mean PR=53.3%±31.1%, Mean ISR=0.040±0.037。跨 seed 极不稳定（PR std=31pp），与 FOL exec-only 一致。ISR 始终极低（<0.1），确认 Prolog exec-only 不产生 genuine reasoning traces。
